title: Derived localizations on opens in the ambient Hom universe
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and suppose the localization defining $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] has morphisms in universe $w$. Then there exists a dependent family, over all open subsets $U$ of $X$, of chosen localizations of complexes of $\mathcal O_X|_U$-modules at quasi-isomorphisms whose morphisms also lie in universe $w$.

source.place: Tag 08BT, exact extension-by-zero/restriction derived adjunction; Mathlib HasDerivedCategory.standard and localization universal property

proof.text: Use HasDerivedCategory.standard for modules on U. Obtain exactness and the extension-by-zero/restriction adjunction from lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact; its two adjoints are additive. The natural isomorphism E followed by R to identity from lem-pc-open-extension-restriction-iso induces D(E) followed by D(R) isomorphic to identity, using the proved source-library mapDerivedCategoryCompIso, mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso. Faithful.of_comp_iso therefore makes D(E) faithful. Full faithfulness and a derived adjunction are unnecessary for the size assertion.

The chosen ambient derived category has Hom universe w. Apply locallySmall_of_faithful to D(E), giving LocallySmall in universe w for the standard derived category on U. Apply MorphismProperty.hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall to DerivedCategory.Q and the quasi-isomorphism class. This constructs HasDerivedCategory in universe w for U. Establish pointwise Nonempty first, then apply Classical.choice for each U to obtain the dependent family.

proof_origin.based_on: Stacks Tags 00A7(4), 08BT; Mathlib Localization.LocallySmall and source-library exact derived functor functoriality

mathlib_searches.query: An exact fully faithful functor with exact adjoint induces a fully faithful functor on unbounded derived categories

from.place: proof, first step: compare the dualizing sheaves of the source and target under the finite morphism; open localizations needed by the perfect-generation and compactness interfaces
